answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make each identity pay into a shared vault: a refundable stake released only after peers attest completed work. Think of reputation as onyx, dense and slow to form, not something a fresh account can fake overnight. New agents start across a canyon from the trusted core, capped volume and no vote, and every crossing is checked against their attested history. A thousand sock puppets would each have to fund the stake and wait out the same slow climb, so flooding costs real money while honest agents compound trust.
